body:
I just had a quick look on the phone so sorry if I missed a few things. The idea was to make them class methods (ie not taking self). The reasoning here is that we call this from the pool as well and the pool shouldn't have a strong reference to a Django database connection -- I already made that mistake by not making _init_connection a free function. I wonder if/how we can salvage that at all since even ops was initialized with self :/

Sorry about that, pushed some tweaks, this should hopefully be going in the right direction :+1:
@chardenberg Would you like to take a look at this work, solving ticket-35688 reported by you?

@apollo13 I have pushed a separated commit (to be squashed once we are happy with the final result), including what I enumerated above. I also settled on `_configure_timezone` for the name of the internal bits, to mimic `_configure_connection`.

Let me know what you think, thanks!

Ah fair enough. Didn't remember that it was available. That said iirc it is not used anywhere from Django. So having the public method and the private one feels like one to many for overriding. No strong feelings though (less functions to call would be a bit faster ;))
